action_inputs.description: Azure VM size applied by the Terraform template, e.g. Standard_B2s.
action_inputs.label: VM Size
action_inputs.name: vm_size

description: Day-2 action: targeted Resize for an HCP Terraform VM deployment. Presents only the vm_size variable with the deployment's current size pre-selected (read from the tfc_var_vm_size custom-field mirror), fails fast if the workspace already has a non-final run pending, snapshots the prior values of ALL allowlisted variables, upserts the FULL variable set (the snapshot overlaid with only the new size -- the other variables ride along unchanged), and runs with a human plan-approval pause: 'Continue Job' approves and applies, canceling rejects -- the run is discarded and the workspace variables are reverted to the snapshot. Depending on the Terraform template, applying a size change may restart the VM.
name: Resize
